NC_META.note: NC status is derived from the action statuses: all actions Completed = Closed; any action started = In Progress. "tbd" means the NC has open actions with no due date yet.
NC_META.ownerNote: Demo data. Open actions sit with the Compliance Manager unless stated otherwise.

NCS.summary: No technical endpoint controls; sampled laptops without full disk encryption
NCS.finding: A.8.1 requires managed and protected endpoints, but nothing prevents non-compliant devices being used. Sampling found laptops without disk encryption.
NCS.rootCause: Endpoint protection relied on policy and manual setup rather than centrally enforced controls.

NCS.summary: No demonstrable risk-owner acceptance of residual risks
NCS.finding: Risk owner acceptance of the treatment plan and residual risks could not be demonstrated.
NCS.rootCause: The procedure did not define what acceptance evidence to record.

NCS.summary: Environmental aspects assessed inconsistently between sites
NCS.finding: Significance assessments lack a factual basis and differ in method between sites.

NCS.summary: Audit plan for the outsourced internal audit not available
NCS.finding: No audit plan or coverage evidence could be shown for the ISO 9001 internal audit.
NCS.rootCause: The engagement did not specify required deliverables.

NCS.summary: Office – Northgate: no fire extinguisher inspection record for the kitchen area
NCS.finding: The kitchen fire extinguisher has no current inspection record.

NCS.summary: Consider informing the certification body of significant events
NCS.finding: Consider adding a step to inform the certification body of significant events that may indicate an ineffective management system.

NC_ACTIONS.action: Inventory all endpoints and enable full disk encryption where missing. SoA entry for A.8.1 set to partial.
Enrol all endpoints in device management with enforced compliance policies.
Re-verify the A.8.1 SoA entry before restoring implemented status.
Each risk owner records acceptance of treatment and residual risk in the register.
Update the risk procedure with an explicit acceptance step and evidence requirements.
Add acceptance columns (accepted by, date) to the risk register template.
Re-assess all aspects using quantified data and record the basis.
Define one group-wide significance method with quantified criteria.
Obtain the audit plan and evidence from the external auditor, or re-perform the audit.
Publish an integrated internal audit programme covering all three standards.
Have the kitchen extinguisher inspected and add it to the office safety checklist.
Add certification body notification to the incident procedure.
